build_BasicTransform: build a BasicTransform 3D convolution block with Tx3x3 and 1x3x3 kernels for video feature extraction
build_X3DTransform: build an X3DTransform block with 1x1x1, Tx3x3 depthwise, and 1x1x1 projection layers with optional SE attention
build_BottleneckTransform: build a BottleneckTransform block with Tx1x1, 1x3x3, and 1x1x1 convolution layers for video ResNet
build_ResBlock: build a ResBlock residual block with skip connections and optional drop path regularization for video models
build_ResStage: build a ResStage with multiple ResBlocks and optional nonlocal layers for multi-pathway video recognition networks
